BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the taxpayer choice act; adding a newsection to chapter 43.79 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature with this act intends toprovide an option for taxpayers to voluntarily contribute more to stategovernment. The legislature recognizes that citizens who desire tocontribute more to finance state government should have a convenientway to do so and therefore the taxpayer choice account is created inthe state treasury.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.79 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The taxpayer choice account is created in the state treasury. Allreceipts from citizens' voluntary contributions, donations, gifts,bequests, grants, or other sources granted or given for this accountmust be deposited in the account. Money in the account may be spentonly after appropriation. Expenditures from the account may be usedfor any general fund or transportation purpose.
This act may be known and cited as thetaxpayer choice act.
